continuity: Ju Hwaran has identified at least two Yongbong Escort Bureau escort captains as likely collaborators in Heo Jun's scheme and is beginning a deliberate purge.
Song Ilseom will stay for roughly one month to help Ju Hwaran expose and remove the bureau's traitors, then plans to go to Xianyang for an elixir for Ju Hogun.
The elixir Song Ilseom spent more than two years seeking is less potent than the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng and is expected to treat Ju Hogun's qi deviation.
A force of five fast ships from the Water Dragon Stronghold, a major river stronghold of the Yangtze River Channel League, is pursuing a passenger ship in Sichuan.
plot: At midnight, Ju Hwaran and Song Ilseom confirm that Heo Jun could not have ruined the Yongbong Escort Bureau's contracts, siphoned its funds, and falsified its ledgers alone. Hwaran suspects at least two other escort captains and intends to root out the entire conspiracy. Song Ilseom agrees to remain for one more month to help her, then plans to travel to Xianyang for an elixir that can treat Ju Hogun's qi deviation. The elixir took him more than two years to find and cost the fortune he earned as the Soul-Chasing Guest. Song Ilseom and Ju Hwaran also recall his ten-year promise to protect her and the bureau in repayment for Ju Hogun's family's lifesaving kindness.

In Sichuan, five fast ships carrying nearly three hundred members of the Water Dragon Stronghold pursue a passenger ship. The shipmaster tries to collect a toll from the passengers, while a young martial artist and a giant discuss taking one of the approaching ships.

Render 수룡채 as Water Dragon Stronghold.

active_continuity: Song Ilseom is Song Pyosan’s son and was known ten years earlier as the Soul-Chasing Guest; he has won 102 life-and-death duels.

Song Ilseom’s grandmother was the surviving child of the Guangdong Chen Family rescued by Ju Gongsan; she fled with infant Song Pyosan, gave Song Ilseom the jade hairpin and family history, and died when he was ten.
The Guangdong Chen Family’s martial arts were lost when the family was burned, and Song Ilseom developed his ability through battlefield experience after working as a sword boy.
Ju Hwaran remains the Yongbong Escort Bureau’s Young Bureau Head and is investigating at least two escort captains suspected of aiding Heo Jun’s scheme.
Ju Hwaran gave Taekyung a Hundred-Year-Old Snow Ginseng, which he accepted.
Taekyung’s party has departed the Yongbong Escort Bureau for Sichuan with Jeok Cheongang unconscious on a pack frame.
Taekyung possesses the Thousand-Year Snow Ginseng.
Taekyung must find the Divine Physician in Sichuan within Jeok Cheongang’s remaining treatment window.
Song Ilseom will remain for one month to help Ju Hwaran purge the bureau’s traitors, then seek an elixir for Ju Hogun in Xianyang.
A Water Dragon Stronghold force of five fast ships and nearly three hundred men is pursuing a passenger ship in Sichuan.
The Zhongnan Sect’s other conspirators and the organizers behind the broader scheme remain unidentified.
open_questions: Who sought the Guangdong Chen Family’s Peak martial arts, and what happened to the other members of the family?
How will Song Ilseom’s Guangdong Chen lineage affect the Yongbong Escort Bureau and the wider Murim?
Which other Yongbong Escort Bureau members collaborated with Heo Jun, and how far does the internal conspiracy extend?
How will the Zhongnan Sect’s Sect Leader and Elders respond to the exposed scheme, and what consequences will Hwangbo Eom’s defeat, Heo Jun’s betrayal, and Zhongnan’s coercion cause within the Murim?
Where is the Divine Physician in Sichuan, and can Jeok Cheongang be treated within the remaining window?
